verdictStatement: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The central equality test passes in four places: the two-class list is == equal in the join, in live G19 v1's namedCorpusNotAuthored, in live catalog v1's, and in live G19 v1's namedCorpusClasses memberVerbatim, which also makes the join's own 'list-equal to namedCorpusClasses memberVerbatim' assertion true as measured. OBL-G19-NAMED-CATALOG carries leftoverDesign false in specifiedNotLeftover, scoped to the naming claim and expressly declining to close the fixture obligation, while all four obligations the dispatch protects — OBL-G19-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-GRANT-JOURNAL, OBL-INHERIT-BLOCKED and OBL-MONOTONIC — remain leftoverDesign true and are exactly the four members of the leftover set. Those four classifications rest on quotations rather than assertions, so I located each one in live bytes: all three cited v11 whatThisDoesNotDo lines and the v11 g19.scope line are present verbatim, and G19 v1's dr113Split supports the OBL-PURGED ride. Nothing is invented: no journal field name, record shape, sequence or monotonic value appears, every PURGED occurrence is a source quotation or a denial, and both D9 mentions are denials. All twenty-three cited path/digest pairs measure equal with zero mismatches, recordedInputs.HEAD equals the top-level head and live HEAD, nothing is SATISFIED, no DR-G* row is added, required-now is 26, and the subject and v1 both did not move. Four further refutations of my own — an invented PURGED encoding or misclassified OBL-PURGED, a minted D9 or loss code, overstated cited standings, and an added gate row — all failed against live bytes.
